summary: # Marvelous Designer Quick Start Guide (2025 Updated Version) - p05: Sewing Panel Pieces ## Introduction In this video, we will learn how to effectively use the sewing machine tool set in Marvelous Designer. This guide will cover both the 2D and 3D windows, demonstrating how to sew pieces together and utilize various sewing tools effectively. ## Sewing Machine Tool Set ### Overview Before we start sewing the finished version, let's learn about the sewing machine tool set. The sewing machine tool set can be found in both the 2D and 3D windows, and their operation differs slightly. ### Using the Sewing Machine Tool 1. **Sewing Two Lines Together**: - Select the sewing machine tool and click on the first line. - Move the mouse to the second line. - Before creating the sewing machine connection, refer to the preview effect to ensure the direction is correct. - After confirming the direction, click the second line to complete the sewing machine connection. 2. **Identifying Lines**: - The sewing machine tool identifies lines that are interrupted and connects them with a straight line. ## Sewing in the 3D Window ### Steps to Sew in 3D - Click the first line, then click the second line. - Note that the sewing machine tool in the 3D window operates the same way as in the 2D window. - If the direction is opposite, the sewing machine will cross. In this case, switch to the editing sewing machine tool: - Right-click on the incorrect sewing machine and choose to change it to correct the direction. ### Free Sewing Machine Tool - For a more flexible sewing option, use the free sewing machine tool: - Right-click, move the mouse along the sewing direction, and click again to finish selecting the sewing line. - Repeat the steps for the second sewing line, observing the blue dot that indicates the endpoint, which matches the length of the first sewing line. ## Editing Sewing Lines ### Using the Edit Sewing Machine Tool - To edit a sewing line, drag the endpoint of the free sewing line to the desired straight line. - You can also drag the endpoint to the opposite side of the sewing line. - To delete a sewing line, right-click and select "delete sewing" from the menu, or simply press the delete button. ### Sewing Multiple Lines Together - It's recommended to create sewing lines in the 2D window when sewing multiple lines together: - Click the first line and hold down the Shift key, which will change the color of the sewing line to yellow-green, indicating a 1 to n sewing line creation. - Click to select two lines from left to right, then release the Shift key to complete the creation. - Don't forget to include the sewing line in the middle. ### Confirmation of Sewing Lines - When creating sewing lines, ensure you follow the correct order: - Click on the good side of the line in the direction of the sewing line. - If there is a mistake during the creation process, use the Backspace key to return to the previous step. - Press the Enter key to confirm your selection. ## Finalizing Sewing Lines ### Using Line Sewing Tool - Use the line sewing tool with the shortcut key **N** to create sewing lines between panels. - Select the top panel, right-click, and choose the frozen panel in the candy window. This action will fix the panel in 3D space. - Press the Control key to open the simulation, allowing you to see the properly sewn structure. ### Opening Existing Projects - Go to the file menu in the upper left corner to open previously saved projects. - Use the line sewing tool in the 2D window to reference the effects shown in the video and complete the sewing lines. ## Creating the Pocket Sewing Line ### Steps to Create Pocket Sewing - When creating the sewing line for the pocket, it is more convenient to use the free sewing tool: - Click the starting point, move the mouse along the sewing direction, and then click the endpoint. - Repeat this for the inner line of the large body. - In the 3D window, ensure to return to the previous operation if needed, using the Control key. ### Adjusting the Sewing Line - If the pocket has a shorter edge, it will automatically select the shorter edge when using the free sewing tool. - Adjust the angle to prevent the panel from obstructing the selection of the sewing line. ## Simulation and Automatic Sewing ### Opening the Simulation - After completing the sewing lines, open the simulation using GPU simulation settings for quality and speed. - The clothing will be influenced by gravity and the sewing lines, fitting the virtual model. ### Using Automatic Sewing Function - For simpler clothing structures, you can use the automatic sewing function: - Select the ice sewing line tool and press **Ctrl + A** to select all sewing lines, then press the Delete key to remove them. - Temporarily delete the pocket and then add it back. - In the 3D toolbar, select all 3D arrangement positions, allowing all panels to be arranged around the virtual model. ### Final Adjustments - Select the type of clothing and confirm the seam line will be automatically created between the panels. - Rotate the view to check for any missing seam lines before starting the simulation. - Use the adjustment panel tool to select the inner line of the entire pocket and delete any excess seam lines. ## Conclusion This concludes our guide on sewing in Marvelous Designer. In the next video, we will explore further techniques and tools. Thank you for watching!
